rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=214, train_n=0, tv_lambda=0.0005, tv_iterations=120, tv_lr=0.01, tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=tv_iterative iter-6 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). BASE = iter-4 BEST family (clip 0.08), with tv_iterations reverted 160->120 (the budget-proven count -- iter-4 at 160 measured 1227.4s, OVER the 1200s HARD wall; iter-2/3/5 at 120 landed 918-972s). ONE LIVE KNOB: tv_lambda 0.001->0.0005 (HALVE). The solver (solver_tv_iterative.py) reads ONLY tv_lambda/tv_iterations/tv_lr/tv_clip_max in tv_reconstruction(); tv_decay/tv_init/tv_optimizer are INERT (step decay is hard-coded 0.01). TRAJECTORY (NUMBERS, 120 iters unless noted): iter-1 SSIM 0.922979 hr 0.132941 RMSE 8.573e-4 (clip 0.05); iter-2 SSIM 0.923844 hr 0.205364 RMSE 7.857e-4 (clip 0.08) = BEST-at-120, #4 on Mayo; iter-3 SSIM 0.919984 hr 0.136636 RMSE 8.536e-4 (lambda 0.001->0.003) REGRESSED over-smoothed; iter-4 SSIM 0.926664 hr 0.208547 RMSE 7.825e-4 (iters 120->160, 1227.4s OVER WALL); iter-5 SSIM 0.926072 hr 0.187286 RMSE 8.036e-4 (lr 0.01->0.02, 971.8s) REGRESSED -- GD OVERSHOOT at the larger step (falsifier-branch a). LEVER MAP: clip exhausted (at top of bound [0.03,0.08]); lambda-UP regressed (iter-3); iters-UP plateaued +0.003hr AND breached wall (iter-4); lr-UP regressed via overshoot (iter-5). The ONLY untried direction on the only unexhausted lever is lambda-DOWN. FAILURE MODE: at lambda=0.001 the data term dominates but the TV penalty still lightly over-smooths real anatomy edges/bone; the RMSE-sensitive headroom metric penalizes that residual smoothing. HYPOTHESIS: halving tv_lambda 0.001->0.0005 weakens the TV penalty so the data term recovers finer edge/bone detail, dropping val_rmse below iter-2 7.857e-4 (the apples-to-apples 120-iter reference) so hr rises above iter-4 BEST 0.208547 at ZERO extra compute. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.208547 (no gain either side), lambda=0.001 was already at the TV regularization optimum (both lambda-UP@0.003 and lambda-DOWN@0.0005 regress), confirming ~0.21 hr is the STRUCTURAL classical-TV ceiling on real Mayo LDCT and this lever is EXHAUSTED. BUDGET: zero-marginal-compute knob at the budget-proven tv_iterations=120 -> ~928s wall (77% of 1200s, ~272s margin; +10% variance ~1018s still under). val = ALL 214 L277 slices unchanged. sbatch --time=00:30:00 SLURM safety net.
